high_level_description: The image depicts a man standing on a wooden pier by the water during what appears to be either sunrise or sunset, given the warm hues in the sky. The man is dressed in a stylish, tropical-themed outfit consisting of a short-sleeved shirt and matching shorts. The shirt features a white base with green and beige geometric patterns, along with a palm tree design on the left side. He is accessorized with a silver necklace, a watch on his left wrist, and a bracelet on his right wrist. He is holding a stemmed glass, possibly containing a cocktail, in his right hand.
